subject: th-cont
title: TH.CONT.------(R)PRO.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 94 (WAM-36). TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PRO-DY is the partner, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From the subject: INDIV-T. From INDIV-T: AFI (affinity insight). From AFI: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and EXT-F (extended functionalism). From EXT-F: ISF-F, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) and C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism). MT-INFO (multi-information) is on a dotted line from EXT-F.
